name: classify
expr: [c, err, post, logp] = classify(sample, training, group);
comment: Sig: [c, err, post, logp] = classify(sample, training, group[, type]). LDA (default 'linear') or QDA ('quadratic'); also 'diaglinear', 'diagquadratic'. Empirical priors n_k/N. Cholesky-factor approach for numerical stability.
